verdict.rationale: Polar acts as Merchant of Record and states in its own docs that it calculates, collects, and remits taxes worldwide, and takes on the liability for international sales taxes. It also offers tax-inclusive pricing controls at the organization and price level. The evidence is brief first-party claims with no detailed tax-mechanics documentation and no independent corroboration. missing for 10: detailed docs on per-jurisdiction VAT/GST/sales-tax calculation (e.g. tax IDs, B2B reverse charge, tax breakdown on invoices), independent or hands-on corroboration of correct tax on every transaction

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can calculate and collect the correct sales tax, VAT, or GST on every transaction automatically

citations.quote: As your Merchant of Record, we handle all international tax compliance. We calculate, collect, and remit taxes worldwide.
We take on the liability of international sales taxes globally for you.
Polar gives you fine-grained control over this behavior at both the organization level and on individual product prices.
